cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do I bring my own towel when I visit now? I'd rather pack correctly than improvise in your bathroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which one, please? The guest towel or the one that's always been mine? We should be precise about the linen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then after I use it, do I wash it and put it back on that hook, or leave it with the guest laundry? I need the routine, not just where it is today.
